observations.source_title: Apa Itu Komputer? Ini Pengertian, Sejarah, hingga Jenisnya
observations.observation: The article describes komputer as an electronic device that receives and processes digital data, and says it can store and retrieve data.
observations.page_location_or_query: Article opening paragraphs under the headline; definition paragraph beginning “Dikutip dari Techtarget”.
observations.limitations: The article also quotes external definitions; this observation establishes the sense used in the Indonesian article, not an independent technical definition.

observations.source_title: Apa Itu Komputer? Ini Pengertian, Sejarah, hingga Jenisnya
observations.observation: The article says computer use is not unfamiliar to most people and that computers help many people complete work, using komputer in ordinary explanatory Indonesian.
observations.page_location_or_query: Opening paragraph: “Penggunaan komputer saat ini bukanlah sesuatu yang asing bagi kebanyakan orang.”
observations.limitations: One explanatory article is evidence of contemporary intelligibility and use, not a frequency measurement across the population.

observations.source_title: 761 Pelajar Cemerlang SPM 2025 Di Kelantan Terima Komputer, Bantuan Awal Pengajian
observations.observation: The report says 761 students received komputer riba and uses komputer in reporting an everyday education support program in Kelantan.
observations.page_location_or_query: Opening paragraph and photo caption describing recipients receiving komputer riba.
observations.limitations: The compound komputer riba appears in a news report; one article cannot quantify how common the standalone word is.

observations.source_title: 761 Pelajar Cemerlang SPM 2025 Di Kelantan Terima Komputer, Bantuan Awal Pengajian
observations.observation: The report identifies komputer riba as an item given to students for further study, consistent with komputer naming a computing device.
observations.page_location_or_query: Opening paragraph: recipients “menerima komputer riba dan bantuan awal” for entry to higher education.
observations.limitations: The passage identifies a laptop rather than defining all computer types.

observations.observation: The topic page lists Malaysian news headlines using komputer in contexts including students receiving computers, computer games, and laptops.
observations.page_location_or_query: Topic page headline list, including “761 pelajar cemerlang SPM 2025 di Kelantan terima komputer” and “Google Play Games tawar permainan Android pada platform komputer”.
observations.limitations: This source supports Malaysian use only; it cannot establish the proposed shared Indonesian and Malaysian relation by itself.

observations.source_title: Ramai soal Larangan Memotret di Stasiun dengan Kamera DSLR, Ini Penjelasan PT KAI
observations.observation: The report describes a person intending to take a photo using a DSLR camera, showing kamera as a device used to take photographs.
observations.page_location_or_query: Article opening paragraphs describing a person taking a photo with a kamera DSLR at a station.
observations.limitations: The passage concerns a DSLR camera and photography; it does not specifically discuss video recording.

observations.source_title: Ramai soal Larangan Memotret di Stasiun dengan Kamera DSLR, Ini Penjelasan PT KAI
observations.observation: The article uses kamera in ordinary reporting about taking pictures with a DSLR and professional camera equipment.
observations.page_location_or_query: Headline and opening paragraphs; the report mentions “kamera Digital Single Lens Reflex (DSLR)” and “peralatan kamera profesional”.
observations.limitations: This is a single 2020 news article and does not measure current frequency.

observations.source_title: X lancar ciri Reaksi Video untuk pengguna iOS
observations.observation: The article says users record a video reply directly using a smartphone camera and mentions camera controls such as lens switching and flash.
observations.page_location_or_query: Article body near the end: “merakam video balasan secara terus menggunakan kamera telefon pintar”; earlier paragraph lists camera lens and flash controls.
observations.limitations: This describes a smartphone camera in a video-recording context; it is not a formal definition of all cameras.

observations.source_title: X lancar ciri Reaksi Video untuk pengguna iOS
observations.observation: The report uses kamera in a contemporary account of recording video replies on smartphones and describes camera interface functions.
observations.page_location_or_query: Article body paragraphs on recording a video reply with a smartphone camera and the camera interface’s lens, flash, and audio controls.
observations.limitations: One technology news article supports intelligible current usage but does not establish population-wide frequency.

observations.source_title: X lancar ciri Reaksi Video untuk pengguna iOS
observations.observation: Astro AWANI uses kamera for the smartphone device used to record video, supporting the Malaysian portion of the proposed shared term.
observations.page_location_or_query: Article body: “merakam video balasan secara terus menggunakan kamera telefon pintar”.
observations.limitations: A single Malaysian source cannot establish the proposed relation across both Indonesian and Malaysian Malay.
